datasets.title: Ag nanocrystal nucleation from 1 mM AgNO₃ in liquid-cell STEM (200 kV, 800 nm liquid)
datasets.ref: Woehl, Evans, Arslan, Ristenpart, Browning, ACS Nano 6, 8599 (2012)
datasets.caveats: Silver, not gold: the gold parameters stay at trend. The induction time includes growing to the 5 nm detection limit, which k_n absorbs. The irradiated radius is the model’s beam_r (1 µm), close to the scanned field at 100 kx.

datasets.title: Size change of 4 nm Au particles on a SiNₓ heating chip, 600–850 °C, ≥ 1 h per step
datasets.caveats: Measured in vacuum as evaporation (the particles shrink); the model coarsens (they grow) at the same thermally activated rate, in an inert gas. The factor for oxygen stays at trend.
